changes: Created and expanded docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md. The document now contains the English-only policy, execution phases, reusable translation catalog, and a complete 762-row line-level translation manifest for every Chinese-bearing packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts line.
usage: Open docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md and review the Complete Line-Level Translation Manifest. Approve, rewrite, or defer each review-draft row before starting a later implementation story that edits cli-engine.ts.
expectedOutcome: User can audit every Chinese source line from cli-engine.ts with a proposed English translation in one review document.
actualTranscript: Manifest validation reported sourceCount=762, manifestRows=762, badProposedEnglish=0, fallback=0, malformed=0. lattice validate --story=B-8448 --json reported status=pass and allPass=true.
outcomeDiff: No difference: the document now includes the complete per-line review packet requested.
limitations: The translations are review-draft proposals, not final approved source edits. This story intentionally did not modify packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts.
pitfalls: Initial REVIEW found that a 173-row catalog was not enough for the user review need. The fix was to add a parseable 762-row TSV manifest and mechanically check row count, no Chinese in proposedEnglish, and no fallback placeholders.
